insights.one_liner: Amsterdam recruitment agency placing finance professionals in permanent and interim jobs; its Rotterdam finance role needs no Dutch.

culture.text: A recruitment agency of about 41 people, founded in 2011, specialising in finance professionals for permanent and interim roles.
Says it looks beyond the CV and believes character makes the difference.
Staff studied at the University of Amsterdam, Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences, Erasmus and VU; its own texts are in Dutch.

open.text: Its one current opening, a mid-level finance role in Rotterdam, does not ask for Dutch.
The IND register match is for Greenberg Traurig, LLP, a different firm, so its own sponsor status is unconfirmed.

worth_knowing.text: As a recruiter, its postings are usually for roles at client companies, so check who the actual employer would be.
